assets.name: Strawberry
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Image 1 is the approved strawberry miniature roll cake snail edit target. Prepare ONLY ITS CAKE SHELL WITH TOPPING as one rigid animation layer on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Remove the entire snail animal (head, eyes, eyestalks, mouth, belly, tail); remove ivory background. Reconstruct only the small bottom-left cake edge previously hidden by snail. Preserve the exact cake design: same golden/ chocolate sponge color, same spiral direction, same three areas of embedded strawberry ingredients and the same strawberry topping with cream. Do not add other ingredient types. Maintain original ingredient shapes and thin dark brown outline, original pixel-painted shading and food texture. Shell and topping remain together. Center the whole cake+topping in canvas with modest transparent padding. One upright single cake slice, frontal visible spiral, no feet, no body, no face, no eyes, no other objects, NO text, NO shadow or backdrop, no glow, no checkerboard baked into pixels. This is a layered game asset extraction, not a redesign.
